_doc: The bot's chat copy: reply text (keyed; {0}-style placeholders are filled in order) and inline-button labels with their callback tokens ([label, token]). Bot-specific, so it lives here rather than in browser/js/config. Pinned byte-for-byte by the Goldens/ text goldens.

replies.statusNoImage: Working image: none — send a photo or use /blank.
replies.statusVideo: Video loaded — use /frame n to pick a frame.
replies.statusChatMode: Chat mode: on — plain messages go to the assistant (/chat off to stop).
replies.statusChatSaving: Chat saving: on — the conversation is stored with the active server project (/chat save off to stop).
replies.chatModeOn: 💬 Chat mode on — just send a message and the assistant answers (and edits the image). Slash commands still work as usual. /chat off to stop, /chat clear to forget the conversation.
replies.chatModeOff: Chat mode off. Use /prompt <request> for a one-off question, or /chat to start again.
replies.chatClearedModeOn: 🧹 Conversation cleared — the assistant has forgotten the previous turns. Chat mode is still on.
replies.chatCleared: 🧹 Conversation cleared — the assistant has forgotten the previous turns.
replies.chatUsage: Use /chat to start chatting with the assistant, /chat off to stop, and /chat clear to make it forget the conversation so far. /chat save on|off stores the conversation with the active server project (off by default; bare /chat save shows the setting). For a single question without switching modes, use /prompt <request>.
replies.chatSaveOn: 💾 Chat saving on — after each assistant turn the conversation (text only, never images) is stored with the active server project and restored when you /fetch it again. The bot's only store IS the server project, so anyone that project is shared with can read the conversation (§12.2). /chat save off to stop.
replies.chatSaveOff: Chat saving off. An already-saved chat stays with its project until /chat clear removes it.
replies.chatSaveStatusOn: Chat saving is on — the conversation is stored with the active server project, where anyone it is shared with can read it. /chat save off to stop.
replies.chatSaveStatusOff: Chat saving is off (the default). /chat save on stores the conversation with the active server project, where anyone it is shared with can read it.
replies.chatRestoredOne: 💾 Restored {0} saved chat message — the assistant remembers this project's conversation.
replies.chatRestoredMany: 💾 Restored {0} saved chat messages — the assistant remembers this project's conversation.
replies.chatSaveFailed: Couldn't store the conversation with the server project this time — the chat itself continues; the next successful turn will save it again.
replies.promptWorking: Working on your request… this can take a minute.
replies.promptStopped: Stopped. That request went unanswered — tap Retry to run it again.
replies.chatApiNoProfiles: This bot offers one chat API, set by its operator — there is nothing to switch between.
replies.clearChatConfirm: 🧹 The assistant asked to clear this conversation. Clear it?
replies.clearChatCanceled: Clear canceled — the conversation is kept.
replies.sourcesHelp:
Load a working image from the web — or just send a photo, or paste an image link:
/url <link> — load a single image from a direct link
/sourcesite <link> [count] [filter=img|video|…] [format=…] [name=<regex>] [group=N] — scrape a page's media into the chat
/sourceupload <link> [index] [format=jpg|png|…] [name=<regex>] — scrape a page and load one image to edit
e.g. /sourceupload https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cat 0 format=jpg
replies.drawHelp:
Draw onto the image (coordinates are pixels, or x%,y% of the image):
/draw line x1,y1 x2,y2 …   — a polyline (2+ points)
/draw rect x1,y1 x2,y2     — a rectangle (two opposite corners)
/draw poly x1,y1 x2,y2 x3,y3 … — a closed polygon (3+ points)

Style first with /color /thickness /points /style /fill — see /pen.
replies.filterVariants:
Filter the image: /filter <mode>
bw — black & white
sepia — sepia tone
invert — invert the colours
contour — edge-detect outline
none — clear the filter
…or a colour name/#hex for a duotone tint, e.g. /filter #ff5623
replies.cropUsage:
Crop: /crop <spec> [album]
Edges: x1= x2= y1= y2= — each a % of the image, px, or cm.
e.g. /crop x1=10% x2=90% y1=10% y2=90%
Add 'album' to derive a missing axis from the page proportion (landscape).
replies.connectUsage: Use /connect <url> [token] to connect to a server, e.g. /connect http://localhost:8090
replies.expireUsage:
Set the active project's expiry: /expire <amount>
e.g. /expire 3 days · /expire 1 week · /expire 2 weeks · /expire 1 month · /expire 3 months
Units: day(s), week(s), fortnight, month(s) — the number may lead or follow (e.g. "week 4").
/expire never — keep the project forever.
replies.connectionsUsage: Use /connections to list every connection, /connections admin for the ones connected with the server's admin token, and /connections session for the rest.
replies.expiryNone: This project has no expiry (kept forever).
replies.deleteConfirm: Delete '{0}'{1}? This permanently removes the project for everyone and can't be undone.
replies.desktopLinkLoopback: {0} It points at localhost, so it only works on this machine — set STENCIL_BOT_BROWSER_URL to a public browser app to share it.
replies.desktopLinkUnusable: Desktop links are off — STENCIL_BOT_BROWSER_URL has to be an http(s) address of the served browser app, whose launch.html page carries the hand-off.
replies.pageFormatsHeader: Page formats (portrait, cm) — set one with /format <name>:
replies.pageFormatsFooter: The chosen format is the /blank default page and rides the saved project layout.
replies.connectionsEmpty: No connections. Use /connect <url> [token] to add one.
replies.projectsEmpty: No projects found. Connect to a server with /connect first.
replies.projectsHeader: Projects ({0}) — tap one to load it:
replies.projectsOverflow: …and {0} more — narrow with /projects <url> or open one with /fetch <name|id>.
